conclusion: Two ε2 alleles. Lowest APOE-attributable Alzheimer's risk; associated with type III hyperlipoproteinemia in a minority of carriers.
One ε2 and one ε3. Slightly lower late-onset Alzheimer's risk than ε3/ε3.
One ε2 and one ε4 — opposing alleles. Risk is not the sum of its parts and is poorly resolved; report with caution.
Two ε3 alleles: the reference genotype most risk estimates are expressed relative to.
One ε4 allele. Increased late-onset Alzheimer's risk relative to ε3/ε3; penetrance is incomplete and age-dependent.
Two ε4 alleles. The highest APOE-attributable late-onset Alzheimer's risk; still not deterministic.
